how.body: Connect your bank and HMRC account once. EasyTax pulls your data, categorises everything with AI, and files — whether it's a Self Assessment, VAT return, or full company accounts.
how.priceCaption: No monthly subscription. £24 per HMRC submission (inc. VAT). Early-access signups lock in this founder price for life.
how.step1Desc: Link your Government Gateway ID and business bank account. We pull your records automatically — no manual data entry.
how.step2Desc: Our AI categorises every transaction, calculates allowable expenses, and prepares your return or company accounts.
how.step3Desc: Check a plain-English summary of your return and submit directly to HMRC — instantly confirmed.

faq.q1A: Yes. EasyTax supports both sole traders / freelancers (Self Assessment, MTD ITSA) and limited companies (VAT returns, CT600 Corporation Tax, Balance Sheet, and P&L). Pricing: £24 per HMRC submission (inc. VAT), no monthly subscription. Early-access signups lock in the £20+VAT founder price.
faq.q2Q: What VAT schemes do you support?
faq.q2A: We support Standard, Flat Rate, and Annual VAT Accounting schemes, filed directly to HMRC via MTD-compliant APIs.
faq.q3Q: How is the Balance Sheet generated?
faq.q3A: EasyTax automatically derives your Balance Sheet from your reconciled bank transactions, categorised income and expenses, and opening balances you provide during setup.
faq.q4Q: What is the CT600 and do I need it?
faq.q4A: CT600 is the Corporation Tax return every UK limited company must file with HMRC each year. EasyTax prepares and submits it based on your P&L and company accounts.
faq.q5A: Your credentials are never stored. We use them to fetch your records via a secure, encrypted connection and discard them immediately after.
faq.q6A: Online Self Assessment returns are due 31 January each year. VAT returns are due one month and seven days after each VAT period ends. EasyTax tracks all your deadlines automatically.
